_comment: Customer-editable. Canonical source_facts keys for hls.reg-submission-authoring.v1. source-ingest writes these exact keys; section-draft and consistency-check match on them. Descriptions say what the key holds, not what its value is.
naming_rule: snake_case; subject/population counts end in _n; dates end in _date; one verbatim string per reported result (keep estimate, CI and p-value together - never split a result into several keys)
unlisted_fields: Name by naming_rule, flag it as 'not in field-dictionary' in the ingest summary, and ask the sponsor to add it here

fields.enrolled_n: Count of subjects enrolled, verbatim from the subject-disposition TLF
fields.randomized_n: Count of subjects randomized, verbatim from the subject-disposition TLF
fields.completed_n: Count of subjects who completed the study, verbatim from the subject-disposition TLF
fields.safety_population_n: Count of subjects in the safety population, verbatim from the subject-disposition TLF
fields.population_definition: Analysis-population definition, verbatim from the SAP analysis-populations section
fields.database_lock_date: Database lock date, verbatim from the TLF header
fields.primary_endpoint_result: Primary endpoint result as one verbatim string from the primary-endpoint TLF
fields.teae_subjects_n: Count of subjects with >=1 treatment-emergent adverse event, verbatim from the TEAE TLF
fields.serious_ae_subjects_n: Count of subjects with >=1 serious adverse event, verbatim from the SAE TLF
fields.data_cutoff_date: Data cut-off date, verbatim from the TLF header
